# komodo_tag (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo tag by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_tag" "production" {
  id = "production" # ID or tag name
}

output "production_tag_color" {
  value = data.komodo_tag.production.color
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Tag ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String)
- `name` (String)
